name: pingone-signin-lab
description: Offline mock PingOne pi.flow sign-in lab: drive a flow step by step, watch the session-token cookie rotate, and see PKCE, replay, lockout, step-up (RFC 9470) and CIBA behave. Mock only, no tenant, no outbound network.

scripts.dev: echo "run: npm run dev -w server  and  npm run dev -w web (UI on http://localhost:6173/)"
scripts.test: npm test -w core && npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.js
